claims.evidence: Witness report identifies Nikon D3300 18-55 VR II Kit from box text, but no sensor specs are shown in the photos.
No FPS/specs are visible in the witness photos.
No AF-point/specs are visible in the witness photos.
Witness report shows box text clearly reading “D3300” and “18-55 VR II Kit” (Photo 0 and Photo 1).

risks.risk: Wrong model / misrepresentation risk (D3400 claimed, but box text shows D3300). This affects value and buyer expectations.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera body model marking (e.g., “D3300”/“D3400” on the front/top) and the menu “About” screen showing the exact model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case mismatch: treat as D3300 kit only if confirmed; otherwise price as not reliably identified / potentially misrepresented.

risks.risk: Functional condition unknown (shutter count, sensor health, autofocus accuracy, button/port tests not shown).
risks.proof: A short video/clip showing: autofocus lock on a target, live view focus, and a shutter actuation test; plus a screen showing shutter count (if available via in-camera/utility).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with unknown functionality (assume possible faults) and discount accordingly.

risks.risk: Lens condition unknown (glass scratches, fungus, haze, separation, mount wear not shown).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both lens elements (front and rear) under light, plus a shot of the lens at wide open showing haze/fungus; also a photo of the lens mount contacts.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case lens condition (possible haze/scratches) until proven clean.

risks.risk: Accessories completeness unknown (battery, charger, caps, strap, cables, manuals, warranty card not shown).
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of every included item with labels (battery model, charger, caps, strap, USB cable, SD card if any, manuals).
risks.if_unproven: Price as body+lens only (no extras) until the full kit is confirmed.

risks.risk: Battery health/charge holding capacity unknown; may affect usability and resale.
risks.proof: A clip showing the battery level over time during operation (shooting a short burst/video) and the battery model number; ideally a battery health readout if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as battery health unknown (assume reduced capacity).

risks.risk: Storage media/firmware status unknown (SD card not shown; firmware not shown).
risks.proof: Photo of included SD card (if any) and a menu screenshot showing firmware version.
risks.if_unproven: Price as no SD card and firmware not verified.

proof_requests: Confirm the exact model by sending a clear photo of the camera body model marking and a menu “About” screen showing the model (D3300 vs D3400).
Send a short video showing autofocus lock (through viewfinder and/or live view), then a burst shot test.
Send close-up photos of the lens front and rear elements under bright light to check for scratches, fungus, and haze.
Lay out and photograph all included accessories (battery, charger, caps, strap, cables, manuals/warranty).
Show battery health/usage test (battery level over a short shooting clip) and the battery model number.
Show whether an SD card is included and provide a firmware version screenshot.
response.reason: The photos identify a Nikon D3300 18-55 VR II kit from box text, while the seller claims D3400; functionality and lens/accessory condition are not verifiable from the provided shots, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set without key proof.
